Sprung.et:
From Middle High German sprung, from Old High German sprung, sprunc, ultimately from the root of the verb springen (“to leap”).
Compare Dutch sprong and Icelandic sprunga (“crack”).

Spruch.et: From Middle High German spruch, from Old High German *spruh, from Proto-West Germanic *spruki (“saying”), related to the verb *sprekan (“to speak”). Cognate with Dutch spreuk, German Low German Spröök.
